label: bug
file: src/notifications/rollup.ts

The issue describes a discrepancy in the timing of the Monday summary email for users in different time zones (Sydney vs. London), despite correct timezone settings. The logic in `isRollupDue` and `sendWeeklyRollups` relies on `SEND_HOUR` (hardcoded to 8) and `startOfWeek` to determine when to send emails. The bug likely stems from how the week start or local time calculation interacts with time zones, causing emails to be sent on the wrong day for users in certain regions (e.g., Sydney).
